name: architecture-design
description: Design deep modules, sharpen a project's domain model, and draw the result. Shared vocabulary for module depth, interfaces, and seams; domain terminology, ADRs, and CONTEXT docs; a codebase deepening scan with an HTML report; and 45 self-contained HTML/SVG diagram types in the Fabric skin — including lifecycle phase maps — with .drawio, Mermaid, and Excalidraw import. Run setup-matt-pocock-skills once first.
